transcript: Speaker A: എടാ അളിയാ, നീ എവിടെയാ? [Hey brother, where are you?] Speaker B: I am sweeping my room. Speaker A: എന്തോന്ന്? [What?] Speaker B: അടിച്ചു വാരുവാന്ന്. Your English will improve in one month.] Speaker A: ഇതൊക്കെ നല്ല പൈസയാവില്ലേ? summary: A humorous skit featuring two young boys talking on the phone, where one impresses the other with his English speaking skills learned from the MySivi app. The ad highlights the app's AI teacher feature, its affordability with a 1-rupee trial, and its popularity.
